title: What's New: Project Management Receive Project Items with Receipts or Put-Aways(2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Overview of warehouse processes for project purchases
Demo setup with different location warehouse requirements
Creating purchase order for project items
Generating inventory put-aways and warehouse receipts
Posting transactions and registering project consumption

features.name: Warehouse processes for project purchases
features.description: Enables creation of purchase orders for project-related items at locations with directed putaway and pick, warehouse receipt, or put-away requirements. Allows standardized warehouse processes to be used with project purchases.
caveats: When purchase order is linked to project, the putaway step will be skipped since items are consumed immediately

features.name: Inventory put-away generation
features.description: Generates inventory put-away documents for locations that require put-away. Demonstrated with silver location requiring put-away processing.

features.name: Warehouse receipt for project items
features.description: Creates warehouse receipt documents for locations that require receipt processing. Separate receipts are created for different location types with varying warehouse settings.

features.name: Direct purchase order receipt without warehouse processing
features.description: Allows receiving items directly from purchase order at main locations without requiring special warehouse handling of inbound transactions.

quotes.text: Location may require putaway, warehouse receipt, or both when dealing with purchase processes.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the three warehouse handling scenarios that the new functionality supports for project purchases.

quotes.text: It allows you to create purchase orders for locations where directed putaway and pick is enabled.
quotes.why_it_matters: Key capability showing that directed putaway and pick locations are now supported with project purchases.

quotes.text: The white location has the directed putaway and pick setting enabled means this location requires both receipt and putaway steps.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that directed putaway and pick is a location setting requiring both receipt and putaway processing steps.

quotes.text: When purchase order is linked to project, the putaway step will be skipped since items are consumed immediately.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important caveat showing that project-linked purchases skip putaway because items are consumed directly by the project.
